[PREFERENCE] User is considering making roasted sweet potatoes as well.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided tips for achieving crispy outside and fluffy inside for roasted sweet potatoes:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Choose high-starch sweet potatoes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Cut them uniformly.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Dry them thoroughly.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Use high-heat oil.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Season liberally.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Roast at 425°F (220°C).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Don’t overcrowd the baking sheet.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Shake the baking sheet halfway through roasting.
